Corey Haim: Top 10 Best Movies Ranked

Originally published 11 March 2024 · RewindZone Archive

Lists & Recommendations

In this ranking of Corey Haim's top 10 best movies, we've explored the actor's diverse range and remarkable talent. From sci-fi adventures to horror thrillers, teen comedies to heartfelt dramas, Haim consistently delivered captivating performances that left an unforgettable mark on audiences. His ability to embody complex characters, convey genuine emotions, and bring a sense of youthful energy to the screen made him a true standout in the world of cinema. Whether you're a long-time fan or a newcomer to his work, revisiting these films is a reminder of Haim's enduring legacy and the ingrained impact he had on the entertainment industry.

10. Prayer of the Rollerboys (1990)

Director: Rick KingMain Cast: Corey Haim, Patricia Arquette, Christopher Collet

Description: In this sci-fi film, Corey Haim plays a young rollerblader who gets involved in a dangerous underground society, showcasing his versatility in portraying complex characters.

As an avid movie watcher, I have to commend Corey Haim's performance in "Prayer of the Rollerboys." While the film itself may not have been a resounding success, Haim's ability to bring depth and nuance to his character was undeniable. He embodied the rebellious spirit of a young rollerblader drawn into a dark world, captivating audiences with his raw energy and emotional range.

9. Fast Getaway (1991)

Advertisement

Director: Spiro RazatosMain Cast: Corey Haim, Cynthia Rothrock, Leo Rossi

Description: A thrilling action-comedy where Corey Haim's character embarks on a high-speed adventure, highlighting his charisma and action-packed performances.

When it comes to action-comedies, Corey Haim knew how to strike the perfect balance of humour and adrenaline-fueled excitement. In "Fast Getaway," he showcased his natural charisma and comedic timing, making even the most outrageous situations feel believable. Haim's chemistry with his co-stars and his ability to handle physical stunts added an extra layer of authenticity to his performance.

8. Dream Machine (1991)

Director: Lyman DaytonMain Cast: Corey Haim, Evan Richards, Danny Nucci

Description: In this sci-fi film, Corey Haim takes on a futuristic role that showcases his range as an actor in a visually captivating setting.

Stepping into the realm of science fiction, Corey Haim proved his versatility as an actor with his performance in "Dream Machine." While the film might not have been a box office hit, Haim's ability to navigate the complexities of a futuristic world was commendable. He brought a sense of wonder and curiosity to his character, allowing audiences to immerse themselves in the captivating visuals and imaginative storyline.

7. Watchers (1988)

Director: Jon HessMain Cast: Corey Haim, Michael Ironside, Barbara Williams

Description: A horror film where Corey Haim delivers a compelling performance as he encounters mysterious and dangerous creatures, demonstrating his ability to engage audiences in suspenseful roles.

In the realm of horror, Corey Haim left a mark with his performance in "Watchers." His ability to convey genuine fear and vulnerability made the film's suspenseful moments all the more gripping. Haim's chemistry with seasoned actors like Michael Ironside added depth to the on-screen dynamics, allowing him to hold his own in intense scenes. Get ready for some super cheesy, brilliant 80s scares!

6. Silver Bullet (1985)

Director: Daniel AttiasMain Cast: Gary Busey, Corey Haim, Everett McGill

Description: In this horror film, Corey Haim shines alongside seasoned actors in a chilling tale that showcases his early talent and ability to hold his own in intense scenes.

Even in his early years, Corey Haim demonstrated a remarkable talent for horror films. In "Silver Bullet," he stood out among a cast of seasoned actors, holding his own with confidence and poise. Haim's ability to convey a range of emotions, from fear to determination, added depth to his character and kept audiences engaged throughout the chilling tale. His performance was a testament to his natural acting abilities and laid the foundation for his future success in the genre.

5. Dream a Little Dream (1989)

Advertisement

Director: Marc RoccoMain Cast: Corey Feldman, Meredith Salenger, Jason Robards, Corey Haim

Description: A fantasy comedy where Corey Haim's performance adds depth to the storyline, highlighting his chemistry with co-stars and his ability to bring charm to the screen.

In the delightful fantasy comedy "Dream a Little Dream," Corey Haim showcased his charm and comedic timing. His on-screen chemistry with co-star Corey Feldman was undeniable, creating a dynamic duo that captured the hearts of audiences. Haim's ability to navigate the whimsical world of the film with a sense of wonder and humour added depth to the storyline, making it a truly enjoyable experience.

4. License to Drive (1988)

Director: Greg BeemanMain Cast: Corey Haim, Heather Graham, Corey Feldman, Carol Kane

Description: A teen comedy where Corey Haim's comedic timing and youthful energy shine through, making his character endearing and memorable in this coming-of-age classic.

In the iconic teen comedy "License to Drive," Corey Haim delivered a performance that left an engraved mark on audiences. His natural comedic timing and youthful energy made his character both endearing and relatable. Haim's ability to capture the essence of a teenager navigating the challenges of growing up resonated with viewers, cementing his status as a talented young actor. This film remains a beloved classic, and a classic Haim/Feldman partnership.

3. Murphy's Romance (1985)

Director: Martin RittMain Cast: Sally Field, James Garner, Corey Haim

Description: In this romantic comedy-drama, Corey Haim delivers a heartfelt performance alongside seasoned actors, showcasing his ability to bring depth and emotion to his roles.

While "Murphy's Romance" may not be Corey Haim's most well-known film, his performance in it is a true testament to his versatility as an actor. Sharing the screen with seasoned talents like Sally Field and James Garner, Haim held his own with a heartfelt and emotional performance. His ability to convey the complexities of his character's journey added depth to the film's narrative, proving that he was more than just a teen heartthrob.

2. The Lost Boys (1987)

Director: Joel SchumacherMain Cast: Jason Patric, Kiefer Sutherland, Corey Haim

Description: A cult classic horror-comedy where Corey Haim's role as one of the Lost Boys stands out for his youthful exuberance and contribution to the film's iconic ensemble cast.

In the cult classic "The Lost Boys," Corey Haim solidified his status as a talented young actor with his portrayal of one of the iconic Lost Boys. His youthful exuberance and charisma made him a standout in the ensemble cast, bringing a sense of energy and fun to the film's horror-comedy elements. Haim's chemistry with his co-stars was undeniable, and his performance became a defining moment in his career, cementing his place in pop culture history. Most definitely Haim's most remembered film, but the top spot honour goes too...

1.Lucas (1986)

Director: David SeltzerMain Cast: Corey Haim, Kerri Green, Charlie Sheen

Description: In this coming-of-age drama, Corey Haim delivers a poignant performance as the titular character, Lucas, showcasing his early talent and emotional depth on screen.

Topping the list is Corey Haim's standout performance in the coming-of-age drama "Lucas." In the titular role, Haim captivated audiences with his raw emotional depth and vulnerability. His ability to convey the complexities of a young outsider navigating the challenges of adolescence was nothing short of remarkable. Haim's performance was nuanced, honest, and utterly compelling, cementing his status as a rising talent in Hollywood. "Lucas" remains a timeless classic, and Haim's portrayal of the lead character is a true testament to his exceptional acting abilities.
